notes:
Video Studio can create visual references on this PC from the ordinary prompt field. For supported workspaces, type a description, choose a duration and create the clip. A new subject gets a local starting image. A cut back to the same subject reuses its reference. Longer continuous shots extend from the last frame. No manual image upload or screenplay is required.

The feature uses the existing offline quality image model and a CUDA GPU with at least 8 GiB. If that renderer is unavailable, standard text rendering remains available. Supplied images, saved-clip extensions and the separate screenplay workflow retain their existing behavior. Automated checks cover shot timing, subject returns, empty cutaways, unrelated subjects with shared adjectives, and reference fallback.

Source commit 51e885a5f62f44cdea6115c131c2a02cccffa747.

Where the local object detector is installed, a reference with more subjects than explicitly requested can be regenerated once. Only a replacement that meets the requested count is used. An uncertain result never blocks the clip.
On the real local model, the same explicit single-teapot prompt and seed initially produced two detected teapots. The retry selected one yellow teapot after exactly one additional reference draw.
